name: Donatus of Evorea
summary:
Saint Donatus of Euroea was a Greek saint revered by both Eastern Orthodox and Roman Catholics in Albania and Greece. Born into a prominent family, he received an excellent education and went on to become a monk at the renowned Monastery of Patmos. There, he underwent intense spiritual discipline and was particularly drawn to the teachings of St. Anthony the Great, whose ascetic practices Donatus would later emulate in his own life.

Donatus's commitment to his faith led him to dedicate his life to serving others, establishing a network of monasteries and churches throughout the region. His unwavering dedication to his spiritual calling earned him recognition as a saint by both Eastern Orthodox and Roman Catholic traditions. Today, Donatus is celebrated as an exemplary model of Christian devotion and selflessness.

Donatus's legacy extends beyond his own lifetime, influencing generations of Christians who followed in his footsteps. His emphasis on spiritual discipline and service to others has left a lasting impact on the history of Christianity in Albania and Greece.
